author: ETA PRIME
description:
The all-new Retroid Pocket Duo Lite is finally here. In this video, we go hands-on with this budget-friendly dual-screen Android emulation handheld. Featuring the Qualcomm Dragonwing QCS6125 CPU, 6GB of RAM, and active cooling, it is designed to bring the classic clamshell experience into the modern era. We unbox it, test out the dual-screen features in Android 15, and push the emulation limits with Nintendo DS, PSP, Dreamcast, and GameCube. Plus, we run some benchmarks and compare it side-by-side with the high-end AYN Thor to see how it stacks up in the current dual-screen market.
